name: kapicic
description: Stevan Kapicic's Claude Code skills: a ticket-to-PR pipeline, PR review, rebasing, review-bot triage, cloud PR sessions, tracker updates, and rewriting AI-sounding text.

plugins.name: pr-review
plugins.description: Deep, stateful GitHub PR review: full or incremental, with routed review lenses and one consolidated review comment.

plugins.name: unslop
plugins.description: Rewrite AI-sounding text so it is laconic and reads like you wrote it, without losing a fact.

plugins.name: git-pr
plugins.description: Rebase onto or merge in a PR's base branch with intent-preserving conflict resolution, and triage review-bot threads (CodeRabbit, Copilot, Greptile and others).

plugins.name: cloud-pr
plugins.description: Start a claude.ai cloud session that fixes a PR's failing CI or reviews a PR, and get its link back.

plugins.name: tracker-updates
plugins.description: Laconic, goal-oriented project updates, issues and comments for Linear, Jira or GitHub Issues/Projects, drafted for your approval before posting.

plugins.name: ship
plugins.description: Take a change from ticket to review-ready PR: explore, ask, scope, blast-radius map, plan, build, self-hunt and verify. ship-it adds the ticket, a fresh-context review, live tests and a cloud PR watcher.
